minutes-of-meeting-format.0: The minutes of meeting format most Indian offices use is simple, but small gaps cause big problems later. No owners? Tasks drift. Skip the decisions and the same topic comes back next month. Leave out attendance, and nobody can prove who agreed.
minutes-of-meeting-format.1: Inside: a copy-ready MoM format, filled-in examples, variations for company board meetings, colleges, schools and housing societies, plus an email format to send minutes the same day.
minutes-of-meeting-format.4: Notes that answer those 4 questions are minutes. Otherwise, just notes. The difference is explained in [meeting notes vs minutes](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-notes-vs-minutes).
minutes-of-meeting-format.10: Step 3 saves the most time: capture decisions and owners live, not from memory later.
minutes-of-meeting-format.11: Company board meetings in India have their own rules: the minutes of meeting format must follow Section 118 of the Companies Act, 2013 and Secretarial Standard 1 (SS-1). Board minutes need extra details: quorum, directors present in person or by video conferencing, interested directors, and the text of each resolution passed.
minutes-of-meeting-format.12: Minutes must be prepared, signed and kept within 30 days of the meeting, under [Section 118 of the Companies Act, 2013](https://lawx.in/acts/section/24/309/2964). SS-1 is issued by the [Institute of Company Secretaries of India](https://www.icsi.edu/). Our full guide to [board minutes of meeting in India](https://lynkk.ai/blog/board-minutes-of-meeting) covers the format and a sample.
minutes-of-meeting-format.13: Colleges and schools: keep the standard 8-part format and add the committee name and the academic year. Common meetings include staff meetings, IQAC meetings, department meetings, PTA meetings and student council meetings.
minutes-of-meeting-format.15: Student assignment asking for a minutes of meeting format? Use the same structure, and keep the language formal and in past tense.
minutes-of-meeting-format.16: Writing minutes for a cooperative housing society or resident welfare association (RWA)? Add membership details and voting. Society meetings often decide maintenance charges, repairs and vendor contracts, so record figures and votes clearly.
minutes-of-meeting-format.18: Requirements differ by state, so check your society's bye-laws and your state's cooperative societies rules.
minutes-of-meeting-format.19: Sending minutes by email? Use this short format, which works for internal teams and clients.
minutes-of-meeting-format.20: More email wording: our [follow-up email after meeting examples](https://lynkk.ai/blog/follow-up-email-after-meeting).
minutes-of-meeting-format.23: Lynkk (our product) also prepares a Meeting Brief before your next meeting with open action items from the last one, sends tasks to Jira in one click, and lets you search old minutes with Ask Lynkk. Free covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each. Pro costs $15 a month. Compare other options in our list of the [best apps for meeting minutes](https://lynkk.ai/blog/app-for-meeting-minutes).
minutes-of-meeting-format.25: Write who attended, list each agenda item, add 2 to 4 lines on what was discussed, write each decision in one sentence, and list every action with one owner and a deadline. Past tense, no side conversations. One owner and one deadline per action is what makes minutes useful a month later.
minutes-of-meeting-format.26: The person who recorded the minutes prepares them, and the chairperson approves and signs them. Company board meetings: the chairperson signs under the Companies Act, 2013. In housing societies and other associations, the chairperson usually signs after the members approve the minutes at the next meeting.
minutes-of-meeting-format.27: Send draft minutes the same day or within 2 working days, while details are fresh. Section 118 requires company board minutes to be prepared and signed within 30 days. Under SS-1, board minutes are circulated in draft within 15 days, with comments due within 7 days of circulation.
minutes-of-meeting-format.29: Notes are informal and personal. Minutes are the official record of attendance, decisions and actions, and are usually approved at the next meeting. College or school assignment? Use the formal minutes format, written in the past tense with numbered agenda items.
